title: Task-Relevant Hindsight Goal Selection for VLA Reinforcement Learning
scope: Focused 2024–2026 primary-source scouting outside the existing eight candidates, with goal-selection foundations. Not exhaustive venue coverage or novelty certification. N1 reviews goal-selection and auxiliary-weighting objectives and selected author code, selects a source-defined LIBERO task and categorical re-scoring path, and specifies fair baseline information/cost boundaries. No simulator, model inference or learning ran. N2 fixes the source-based task/split rules, paired fixed-pool estimand, pilot uncertainty/budgets and shared token-surrogate objective. Initial-state payload identity and native compatibility remain unverified. P0-PREP adds pinned Docker recipe and bounded observer/re-score/gradient-fixture code. Current local Mac resources fail NVIDIA allocation; 15 stdlib Docker control tests passed. Native image/payload/IO/gradient remain unverified.
decision: Nonexperimental design and P0 packet authoring complete. Retain narrow analysis candidate; no method GO. Next: eligible local NVIDIA check -> build -> prepare -> p0. Native compatibility and scientific effects are unverified.
question: Among multiple true auxiliary goals for the same failed rollout group, which improve the originally commanded task under matched interaction, update and labeling budgets?
user_fit: One VLA policy is updated by RL; no additional deployment controller. Initial scope: single-robot manipulation.

not_estimated: on-policy exploration or converged sample efficiency
pure semantic effect when reward vectors differ

estimand.matched_reward_vector_diagnostic: Only actual equal full reward vectors, not equal success counts; not automatically run in first pilot

ratio.numerator: current parameter score under selected h (or g for original loss)
ratio.denominator: saved behavior theta0 score under original g
ratio.nonfinite: stop stage and report, no selective clipping/drop of offending trials

learning.reduction: mean executed tokens per trajectory, equal mean over K trajectories; not native global token mean
learning.maximize: J_g + lambda*J_h for U/O; J_g for G

optimizer.zero_gradient: retain common step opportunity; record actual delta and Adam state

learning.trainable_parameters: Default full-parameter rlinf modified-OFT path; exact requires_grad list/hash to seal at P0, no automatic LoRA/unfreezing
learning.microbatch: memory-dependent implementation; accumulate exact group reduction before one optimizer step
upstream_overrides: disable relative/dense reward, coef5 and reward group filter
replace global token mean with trajectory then group mean
bound suite env counts/rollouts and optimizer steps
learning.algebraic_note: At theta0, same-goal ratio1 and equal-trajectory mean gives Jg=0 even when the gradient is nonzero. Constant rewards additionally force the reward gradient to zero. Do not calibrate lambda from this scalar objective.

statistics.independent_unit: collection/optimization run conditional on fixed initial checkpoint and state list
statistics.point_estimates: all per-run arm/base success counts, paired differences, mean D

interval.limitation: Three runs and ten states do not establish nominal coverage, power, equivalence or benchmark superiority
